ext_name.message: Open FullScreenshot — Full Page Screen Capture
ext_name.description: Extension name, shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store.

ext_description.message: Capture full-page, visible-area or custom-region screenshots — entirely offline, with no account and no network access.
ext_description.description: Extension description, shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store.

action_title.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the toolbar icon.

cmd_default.description: Description of the _execute_action keyboard command in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmd_fullpage.description: Description of the capture-fullpage keyboard command in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmd_visible.description: Description of the capture-visible keyboard command in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmd_region.description: Description of the capture-region keyboard command in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

menu_options.description: Right-click context menu item that opens the options page.

progress_capturing.description: On-page HUD label while frames are being captured.

progress_stitching.description: On-page HUD label while frames are being combined into one image.

progress_encoding.description: On-page HUD label while the final image is being encoded.

toast_cancelled.description: Toast shown after the user cancels a capture.

toast_copied.description: Toast shown after a successful clipboard copy.

toast_copy_failed.description: Toast shown after a failed clipboard copy.

toast_saved.description: Toast shown after a successful download.

hud_cancel_hint.description: On-page HUD hint shown during capture.

hud_title.message: Open FullScreenshot is capturing this page
hud_title.description: On-page HUD title shown during capture.

select_hint_element.message: Click an element to capture it
select_hint_element.description: On-page hint shown by the selection overlay.

select_hint_region.description: On-page hint shown by the selection overlay.

select_hint_keys.message: Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel
select_hint_keys.description: On-page hint shown by the selection overlay.

err_restricted_url.message: This page can't be captured by an extension.
err_restricted_url.description: Error shown when the active tab is a chrome:// or otherwise restricted URL.

err_no_content_script.message: Open FullScreenshot couldn't reach this page. Try reloading it.
err_no_content_script.description: Error shown when the content script fails to respond.

err_quota.message: Chrome is throttling captures. Please try again in a moment.
err_quota.description: Error shown when Chrome's captureVisibleTab rate limit is exceeded.

err_too_large.message: This page is too large to capture in one image.
err_too_large.description: Error shown when the page exceeds Chrome's canvas size limit even after downscaling.

err_cancelled.description: Error/status code surfaced when the user cancels a capture.

err_clipboard.description: Error shown when every clipboard-write strategy has failed.

err_empty_selection.description: Error shown when the user confirms a selection smaller than 4×4 pixels.

err_file_urls.message: Enable "Allow access to file URLs" for Open FullScreenshot in chrome://extensions to capture local files.
err_file_urls.description: Error shown when capturing a file:// page without the file-access permission enabled.

editor_redact.description: Editor tool rail button — draws opaque rectangles baked into the image.

editor_reset.description: Editor tool rail button — restores the original, unedited image.

editor_cancel.description: Editor — discards the pending crop or redact selection without applying it.

editor_pdf_unavailable.description: Editor — tooltip on the disabled PDF option when the PDF writer failed to load.

editor_save_failed.description: Editor toast — encoding or downloading the image failed.

editor_quality.description: Editor header field label, shown for JPEG/WebP.

editor_truncated_warning.message: Image downscaled to fit Chrome's size limit.
editor_truncated_warning.description: Warning chip shown in the editor status bar when the capture was truncated.

editor_pdf_fit.description: PDF page size option — one page exactly the size of the image.

editor_dimensions.description: Editor status bar label, followed by the image's width × height.

editor_size.description: Editor status bar label, followed by the encoded byte size.

popup_fullpage.description: Popup button — captures the whole scrollable page.

popup_visible.description: Popup button — captures only the current viewport.

popup_select.description: Popup button — opens the on-page selection overlay.

popup_options.description: Popup button — opens the options page.

popup_shortcut_not_set.description: Shown next to a capture button in the popup or options page when no keyboard shortcut is assigned in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

options_default_action.description: Options field label for the defaultAction setting.

options_default_action_desc.message: What the toolbar icon and Alt+Shift+P do.
options_default_action_desc.description: Options field help text for the defaultAction setting.

options_default_action_menu.description: defaultAction option value 'menu' — opens the popup to choose a mode.

options_hide_fixed.description: Options field label for the hideFixed setting.

options_hide_fixed_desc.message: How sticky headers, cookie banners and chat widgets are handled while stitching.
options_hide_fixed_desc.description: Options field help text for the hideFixed setting.

options_pre_scroll_for_lazy.description: Options checkbox label for the preScrollForLazy setting.

options_pre_scroll_for_lazy_desc.message: One fast pass down the page before capturing, so lazy-loaded images have time to appear.
options_pre_scroll_for_lazy_desc.description: Options field help text for the preScrollForLazy setting.

options_settle_ms.description: Options field label for the settleMs setting.

options_settle_ms_desc.message: Extra wait after each scroll step, in milliseconds. 0 lets Open FullScreenshot choose automatically.
options_settle_ms_desc.description: Options field help text for the settleMs setting.

options_scale_mode.description: Options field label for the scaleMode setting.

options_scale_mode_desc.message: Device keeps the full HiDPI resolution; CSS downsamples to 1×.
options_scale_mode_desc.description: Options field help text for the scaleMode setting.

options_max_pixels.description: Options field label for the maxPixels setting.

options_max_pixels_desc.message: Hard ceiling on the stitched image. Chrome cannot draw a canvas larger than about 268 megapixels.
options_max_pixels_desc.description: Options field help text for the maxPixels setting.

options_max_pixels_large.description: maxPixels preset — larger budget, still bounded by Chrome's canvas limit.

options_max_pixels_maximum.description: maxPixels preset — Chrome's absolute canvas size limit.

options_show_hud.description: Options checkbox label for the showHud setting.

options_show_hud_desc.message: Displays an on-page progress indicator with an Escape-to-cancel hint during capture.
options_show_hud_desc.description: Options field help text for the showHud setting.

options_after_capture.description: Options field label for the afterCapture setting.

options_after_capture_desc.message: What happens once the image exists.
options_after_capture_desc.description: Options field help text for the afterCapture setting.

options_format.description: Options field label for the format setting.

options_format_desc.description: Options field help text for the format setting.

options_quality.description: Options field label for the quality setting.

options_quality_desc.message: JPEG and WebP only. Higher is sharper and larger.
options_quality_desc.description: Options field help text for the quality setting.

options_save_as.description: Options checkbox label for the saveAs setting.

options_save_as_desc.message: Show the browser's Save dialog instead of dropping the file straight into Downloads.
options_save_as_desc.description: Options field help text for the saveAs setting.

options_filename_template.description: Options field label for the filenameTemplate setting.

options_filename_template_desc.message: Built from the tokens below. Illegal filename characters are removed automatically.
options_filename_template_desc.description: Options field help text for the filenameTemplate setting.

options_filename_template_preview_label.description: Label preceding the live filename preview.

options_template_legend.description: Heading over the list of filename template tokens.

options_template_token_title.description: Explanation of the {title} filename template token.

options_template_token_host.description: Explanation of the {host} filename template token.

options_template_token_path.description: Explanation of the {path} filename template token.

options_template_token_date.description: Explanation of the {date} filename template token.

options_template_token_time.description: Explanation of the {time} filename template token.

options_template_token_datetime.description: Explanation of the {datetime} filename template token.

options_template_token_width.description: Explanation of the {width} filename template token.

options_template_token_height.description: Explanation of the {height} filename template token.

options_template_token_mode.description: Explanation of the {mode} filename template token.

options_template_token_timestamp.description: Explanation of the {timestamp} filename template token.

options_shortcuts_desc.message: Keyboard shortcuts are managed by Chrome itself, on a dedicated internal page that extensions are not allowed to open automatically.
options_shortcuts_desc.description: Explanation shown above the shortcuts page link.

options_shortcuts_url_label.description: Label for the selectable chrome://extensions/shortcuts text field.

options_shortcuts_copy.description: Button that copies the shortcuts page URL to the clipboard.

options_shortcuts_copied.description: Toast shown after the shortcuts page URL is copied.

options_shortcuts_copy_failed.message: Couldn't copy — select and copy the text manually.
options_shortcuts_copy_failed.description: Toast shown when copying the shortcuts page URL fails.

options_shortcuts_current_label.description: Heading over the list of currently assigned keyboard shortcuts.

options_theme.description: Options field label for the theme setting.

options_theme_desc.message: Applies to the popup, the options page and the editor.
options_theme_desc.description: Options field help text for the theme setting.

options_locale.description: Options field label for the locale setting.

options_locale_desc.message: Preferred language for Open FullScreenshot's own interface.
options_locale_desc.description: Options field help text for the locale setting.

options_reset_button.description: Button that starts the reset-to-defaults confirmation.

options_reset_confirm_message.message: Reset every setting to its default value?
options_reset_confirm_message.description: Inline confirmation message shown before resetting settings.

options_reset_done.description: Toast shown after settings are reset to defaults.

options_about_privacy.message: No network requests. No telemetry. No account. Settings are stored locally on this device only.
options_about_privacy.description: Privacy statement shown in the About section.

options_about_version_label.description: Label preceding the extension's version number, read from the manifest.
